title: Fourier coefficients of constants
statement: Let $G$ be a finite abelian group, let $c\in\mathbb{C}$, and let $\chi$ be an additive character of $G$. The Fourier coefficient of the constant function with value $c$ is $c$ at the trivial character and zero at every other character.
